scope: Historical native-layout review plus current accepted-first/pending-second activation register; no CI policy change.

roles: validate_owned_sources validates exact source hashes/imports/origin and rejects unregistered .lean
parse_audit enforces exact unique ordered sentinels and allowed standard axioms
local_records uses dependency graph from validate
compile_module invokes Lean directly with correct root and output path only in external CI
current modules and object receipts are checked again without duplicate compiler runs
publication revalidates endpoint set and all audit records against current manifests
verified_graph recursively checks actual bytes/imports against closure and source manifests
standalone export generates Lake libraries for namespace roots and endpoint
owned/vendor dependency closure and hash template
registered endpoint inventory used by export and publication
compiler/dependency configuration retained; native additions do not require modifying existing lean_lib list
push on main triggers configured cached external workflow; default native binary backend; two module workers and two Lean threads

owned_source.path_rule: Path relative to Material equals module.replace('.', '/') + '.lean'; owned paths must not start _vendor/.

origin_required.path: nonempty exact source or B-tier basis path

owned_source.note: origin describes provenance/derivation basis, not necessarily byte-identical inherited source. Newly computed sha256 binds actual owned proof bytes.

endpoint.imports_rule: Exact ordered imports parsed from Endpoint.lean; no drift.
endpoint.scope_policy: Every intended public theorem has an independent full signature and complete fresh type/axiom sentinel pair. Definitions/private helpers are transitively checked.

closure.hash_policy: SHA256 of compact sorted-key JSON object containing roots, files, external_imports.
closure.scope: Complete recursive owned and vendor source closure, exact imports and content hashes; no omitted transitive dependency.

inventory.note: Refresh counts only when complete packages are activated; ten logical milestones need not equal ten source files or ten accepted packages.

audit.sentinel_multiplicity: Exactly once per prefix per declaration, in manifest declaration order.

requires: matching external compiler pass at exact source/dependency/policy identity

activation_sequence: Keep this planning revision entirely in PREPRINT_FORMALISATION/EhrenfestObstruction and cumulative B-tier documentation.
Prepare complete proof sources for an independent bottom-up layer only after formalization activation; do not place incomplete/unregistered .lean files under Material.
For the activated layer, add owned source records with exact current bytes/imports and pinned provenance.
Add complete endpoint wrappers, independently stated full-signature audits, endpoint manifests and recursively verified closure manifests together.
Synchronize Material/endpoints.json counts and closure identities; retain all existing packages and audit scope.
Preserve compiler pin, dependency lock, vendor sources, cache identity policy, driver and workflow configuration.
Use authorized external cached verification; no local compiler, no local fallback, no needless full cache clean.
Promote exact milestone only after matching external type/compiler/axiom acceptance; otherwise retain prepared/pending status.

independent_modules: Actual-reference H1 error and eventual bound
Native TestCore/CoreCommutator, independent of complete flow and self-adjointness
independent_work_and_splits.helper_module_policy: Historical design has31 proposed modules and nine logical fast-root blocks. Actual helper splitting and18 active owned sources are recorded in COUNT_RECONCILIATION.json; held scalar root has25 dependencies.
independent_work_and_splits.caution: No planned file is activated or compiled; each full milestone retains all its analytic and audit requirements.

observed_stale_metadata.preparation_status_fields: Many accepted existing endpoint/closure JSON files still say PENDING_EXTERNAL_CI/FIRST_EXTERNAL_COMMIT_PENDING; these are historical preparation metadata, not current theorem status.
observed_stale_metadata.authoritative_status: Source-specific audits/material-fdb515d8/summary.json plus root README/INDEX-WORTHY accepted evidence.
observed_stale_metadata.local_readme: Material/README.md and registry/README.md retain older baselines; do not copy their historical WFB-open status into the new plan.

historical_review_scope: Static layout review for B-tier planning; no implementation, registration, compiler execution, workflow dispatch or repository mutation.
